name: cafe_sit_drink
text: A seated person reaches with the right hand for a cup on a table, raises the cup to the lips, takes one sip, lowers the cup back to the table, then rests the right hand on the lap. Left hand stays on lap.

scene.text: A seated person reaches with the right hand for a cup on a table, raises the cup to the lips, takes one sip, lowers the cup back to the table, then rests the right hand on the lap. Left hand stays on lap.
scene.description: Start at cafe_table.post_cafesit facing the model standing marker direction. A person sits upright at a cafe table with both feet flat on the floor. The LEFT hand stays resting low on the left thigh throughout, below the tabletop, elbow down beside the body. Only the RIGHT hand picks up a cup, raises it to the mouth, takes a sip and returns it to the table. Keep the back upright, knees apart, both thighs forward and parallel. One sip, then put the cup down. Hips touches the physical model marker hip_seat at 0.00s, 5.00s. RightHand touches the physical model marker cup_landing at 1.00s. RightHand touches the physical model marker cup_landing at 4.25s. Grasp held_coffee_cup at grip_sleeve at 1.00s. Release at 4.25s onto cup_landing using the item rest marker. The left hand stays relaxed by the left thigh unless the description explicitly gives it a supporting task. Keep thighs beneath the tabletop, torso at the table edge, and both forearms above the tabletop.
scene.idle_hand: The left hand stays relaxed by the left thigh unless the description explicitly gives it a supporting task.
scene.clearance: Keep thighs beneath the tabletop, torso at the table edge, and both forearms above the tabletop.
